models.name: Overnight momentum
models.thesis: Favor stocks with persistent close-to-open strength and medium-term relative strength.

models.name: Intraday reversal into the close
models.thesis: Buy liquid stocks that were weak during the day but retain a positive overnight history.

models.name: Close strength
models.thesis: Follow a strong close, high close location, and unusual volume into the next open.

models.name: Market-relative strength
models.thesis: Buy stocks whose recent return is strong after removing the benchmark move.

models.name: Risk-adjusted ensemble
models.thesis: Blend momentum, reversal, close strength, and relative strength with a volatility penalty.

notes: One long stock is selected after the close and sold at the next regular-session open; this is an overnight trade, not a same-day flat day trade.
SPY buy-and-hold is the no-turnover total-return benchmark. SPY buy-and-hold matched scales SPY to each model's realized volatility with cash at 4% and borrowing at cash + 50bps.
The fixed universe is liquid large-cap names and ETFs, which leaves survivorship bias; this is a research screen rather than a production claim.
Every Sharpe estimate carries Lo-style standard error, confidence interval, and minimum detectable Sharpe. Rows with a non-positive lower confidence bound are INCONCLUSIVE.
A close-to-open result can be dominated by the opening auction and overnight gaps. Use quote-aware Alpaca paper fills before any capital.
selection_policy: No champion is selected by validation rank. All candidates and the matched benchmarks are reported.
